description: Kommunala parkeringsplatser i Mariestads kommun is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mariestads kommun. Description including coordinates of the parking spots owned and operated by the municipality of Mariestad. Coverage: Mariestads kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Municipally owned parking spots in Mariestad municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mariestads kommun. Its keywords include parkeringsplats, transport, parkering, parking spot, transports, parking. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, HTML, SHP. The listing shows 2020-12-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
